title: rehmannia glutinosa var. japonica
intro: Rehmannia glutinosa var. japonica, commonly known as Japanese Rehmannia or Di Huang, is a plant species in the saxifragaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fatigue, menopausal disorders, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Japanese Rehmannia include acting as an adaptogen, astringent, and expectorant, and it is also used to treat anemia and improve overall cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Japanese Rehmannia include rehmannioside A, rehmannioside B, and rehmannioside C, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
